item.title: Ambuja Cements Q2 net profit plunges 90 pc as margins come under pressure
item.description: Ambuja Cements Ltd reported a 90 per cent year-on-year plunge in consolidated net profit to Rs 236 crore for the September quarter, as higher fuel and logistics costs and seasonal weakness squeezed operating margins at the Adani Group company. The year-earlier profit of Rs 2,336 crore included a Rs 1,697 crore reversal of an income-tax provision, tempering the significance of the reported decline. Revenue from operations rose 0.2 per cent to Rs 9,197 crore in the quarter ended September 30, while operating earnings before interest, tax, depreciation and amortisation (EBITDA) fell 27.9 per cent to Rs 1,271 crore, the company said in its earnings release. Cement sales volume declined 0.6 per cent year-on-year to 16.5 million tonnes. EBITDA per tonne fell to Rs 770 from Rs 1,061 a year earlier, while the EBITDA margin contracted to 13.8 per cent from 19.2 per cent. item.title: TVS Motor to raise e2W capacity to 80,000 units a month by March 2027
item.description: TVS Motor Company plans to increase its electric two-wheeler manufacturing capacity to 80,000 units per month by the end of March 2027 to meet strong demand for electric scooters, according to a senior company official. "Now we are also enhancing the capacity. We are now operating at around 60-65,000 units. We have already planned for the next level of capacity expansion to about 80,000 units," TVS Motor Chief Executive Officer KN Radhakrishnan told investors. Electric vehicle penetration has been growing at a very strong pace in the two-wheeler space. Penetration in the overall two-wheeler market has been around 11-12 per cent, while it has crossed the 20 per cent mark in the scooter segment. TVS Motor is currently the market leader in the electric two-wheeler segment. Its major competitor, Bajaj Auto, is also enhancing Chetak capacity to 80,000 units. Ather Energy is also increasing capacity at its existing facility to over 41,000 units while its new facility is coming up. TVS .

The company said its electric vehicle exports accounted for nearly 93 per cent of India's electric passenger vehicle exports during April-September 2026. The auto major said it exports e VITARA to nearly 50 countries, including the UK, Norway, Germany, Japan and Switzerland, with Europe being its largest export destination. Production of the electric SUV began at its Hansalpur facility in Gujarat in August 2025 for sale in over 100 countries. "Today, Maruti Suzuki exports EVs to nearly 50 of these countries, with Europe being the largest destination.
